jq.name: callback, receipt and closure sources are scoped to this pack and correlate by work unit
jq.expr: (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "change-unit-workspace") | .correlation_field == "work_unit_id" and (.filter | contains("change-unit:%"))) and (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "change-unit-write") | .correlation_field == "work_unit_id" and (.filter | contains("change-unit:%"))) and (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "change-unit-review") | .source_collection == "WorkspaceReceipt" and .workspace_authority == "readOnly" and .correlation_field == "work_unit_id" and (.filter | contains("writer")) and (.filter | contains("change-unit:%"))) and (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "change-unit-record") | .source_collection == "FireOutcome" and .correlation_field == "source_handoff_id" and (.filter | contains("completed")) and (.filter | contains("change-unit-integrate")) and (.filter | contains("change-unit:%"))) and ([.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "change-unit-integrate" or .event_source_id == "change-unit-rejected") | (.filter | contains("change-unit:%"))] | all)

jq.name: writer workspaces default to the plain git_worktree adapter and pass adapter parameters to the callback
jq.expr: (.assets["schemas/change_unit_work.graphql"] | contains("adapter: String @default(value: \"git_worktree\")") and contains("clone_artifacts: [String]")) and (.config.callback_bindings[] | select(.binding_id == "change-unit-workspace") | .input_fields | index("adapter") != null and index("clone_artifacts") != null)

jq.name: the reviewer sees the receipt's changed paths
approval persists exact writer receipt and seal
jq.expr: .config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == "change-unit-review-io") | any(.entries.entries[]; .tool_name == "write_change_unit_closure" and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "writer_receipt_id" and .fill.source_field == "receipt_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "writer_seal_hash" and .fill.source_field == "seal_hash")))

jq.name: terminal results take identity, routing and status from the triggering document
jq.expr: ((.config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == "change-unit-record-io") | .entries.entries[] | select(.tool_name == "write_change_unit_result")) | (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "result_id" and .fill == "correlation")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "work_unit_id" and .fill == "correlation")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "handoff_id" and .fill.source_field == "source_handoff_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "reply_session_id" and .fill.source_field == "reply_session_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "status" and .fill.source_field == "terminal_state"))) and ((.config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == "change-unit-rejected-io") | .entries.entries[] | select(.tool_name == "write_change_unit_result")) | (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "result_id" and .fill == "correlation")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "work_unit_id" and .fill == "correlation")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "handoff_id" and .fill.source_field == "handoff_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "reply_session_id" and .fill.source_field == "reply_session_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "status" and .fill.source_field == "status"))) and ((.config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == "change-unit-failed-io") | .entries.entries[] | select(.tool_name == "write_change_unit_result")) | (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "result_id" and .fill == "correlation")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "work_unit_id" and .fill == "correlation")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "handoff_id" and .fill.source_field == "source_handoff_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "reply_session_id" and .fill.source_field == "reply_session_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "status" and .fill.source_field == "terminal_state"))) and ((.config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == "change-unit-rejected-io") | .entries.entries[] | select(.tool_name == "write_change_unit_result")) | (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "closure_id" and .fill.source_field == "closure_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "implementation_id" and .fill.source_field == "implementation_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "review_id" and .fill.source_field == "review_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "workspace_id" and .fill.source_field == "workspace_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "writer_receipt_id" and .fill.source_field == "writer_receipt_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "writer_seal_hash" and .fill.source_field == "writer_seal_hash"))) and ((.config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == "change-unit-failed-io") | .entries.entries[] | select(.tool_name == "write_change_unit_result")) | (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "failed_request_id" and .fill.source_field == "request_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "failure_stage" and .fill.source_field == "trigger_id")) and (.fields | any(.[]; .name == "failure_reason" and .fill.source_field == "reason"))) and ((.config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == "change-unit-record-io") | .entries.entries[] | select(.tool_name == "read_integrator_receipt")) | .filter_fields | any(.[]; .name == "produced_by_request_id" and .fill.source_field == "request_id"))

jq.name: failed stages share one recorder that may write nothing after a reviewer closure
jq.expr: ([.config.triggers[] | select(.trigger_id | startswith("change-unit-failed-")) | .task_id == "change-unit-failed-task"] | length == 3 and all) and ((.config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == "change-unit-failed-io") | .entries.entries[] | select(.tool_name == "write_change_unit_result")) | .output_obligation == null) and ([.config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == "change-unit-record-io" or .surface_id == "change-unit-rejected-io") | .entries.entries[] | select(.tool_name == "write_change_unit_result") | .output_obligation.minimum_writes == 1] | length == 2 and all)

jq.name: the repository root has no fallback, so an unset variable leaves the placement empty and install fails
jq.expr: (.config.repository_placements[] | select(.repository_id == "change-unit-repository") | .host_path == "") and ([.config.tools[] | select(.tools_id == "change-unit-writer-tools" or .tools_id == "change-unit-review-tools") | .host.root == ""] | all) and (.assets["pack_config.json"] | contains(":-.") | not)

jq.name: atomic stages expose outcomes without routing workers into supervisor sessions
jq.expr: ([.config.tasks[] | select(.task_id == "change-unit-writer-task" or .task_id == "change-unit-review-task" or .task_id == "change-unit-integrate-task") | .emit_outcome == true and .goal_objective_template == null] | all) and ([.config.triggers[] | .session_id_template == null] | all) and ([.config.tasks[] | select(.task_id == "change-unit-record-task" or .task_id == "change-unit-rejected-task" or .task_id == "change-unit-failed-task") | (.emit_outcome // false) == false] | all)

jq.name: every review, closure and result writer requires the unit's attempt, and terminal stages take it from their trigger
jq.expr: ([.config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | .. | objects | select(has("tool_name") and (.kind // "write") != "query" and (.collection == "ChangeUnitResult" or .collection == "ChangeUnitReview" or .collection == "ChangeUnitClosure"))] | length == 5 and all(.fields | any(.[]; .name == "attempt" and .required == true))) and ([.assets["tasks/change_unit_record_task/prompt.md"], .assets["tasks/change_unit_rejected_task/prompt.md"], .assets["tasks/change_unit_failed_task/prompt.md"]] | all(contains("{{ doc.attempt }}") and (contains("when present") | not)))
